meta.name: deslop
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code slop, unnecessary comments, and over-engineering from the current branch diff. Cleans up boilerplate, simplifies abstractions, and strips defensive code. Use when cleaning up code, simplifying, removing boilerplate, or before committing.

copy.tagline: 清理当前分支中AI生成的冗余代码和过度工程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI生成的代码或简化过度设计
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated slop and over-engineering from your branch diff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up AI-generated code or simplify over-engineered code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查当前分支与主分支的代码差异，自动识别并移除 AI 生成的冗余代码、不必要的注释、过度工程化设计，只保留必要改动。
howto.when: 当你完成代码修改后、提交前，或觉得代码过于复杂时，可以要求 Claude 执行清理。

say.text: 帮我清理当前分支的代码冗余。
say.note: Claude 会分析差异并移除 AI 生成的冗余代码。

say.text: 检查并简化这个分支的代码。
say.note: Claude 会识别并移除不必要的注释和过度设计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will check the diff between the current branch and main, identify and remove AI-generated redundant code, unnecessary comments, and over-engineering, keeping only necessary changes.
howto.when_en: Use after completing code changes, before committing, or when code feels over-engineered.

say_en.text: Clean up code slop on the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the diff and remove AI-generated redundancy.

say_en.text: Simplify the code on this branch.
say_en.note: Claude will identify and remove unnecessary comments and over-engineering.
